issues.explanation: Public input properties ($email, $name, $slug, $targetMembershipId) have no #[Validate] attributes and actions use inline $this->validate([...]) or Validator::make instead of the required #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.

Domain writes (addMember, assignRole, removeMember, save, delete, transfer, pick) live directly in Livewire components and the controller instead of one-class-per-use-case app/Actions/* with authorization inside.

conventions.evidence: Follows policies via Gate::authorize, Blade <x-form-field>/<x-button> with {{ }} escaping, Bulma classes, $fillable attributes, reversible migrations, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated; deviations: no #[Validate] on Members.php:113 $email or Settings.php:261-265 $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId (uses $this->validate([...]) and Validator::make at Members.php:126,157), no app/Actions/* for domain writes

readability.evidence: Clear names (findMembership, owner_seq comment at database/migrations/2026_08_01_000001:750-754), small focused methods, consistent sibling style, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_08_01_000000:719 entities_slug_unique + softDeletes; 2026_08_01_000001:752-759 owner_seq storedAs CASE WHEN role='owner' + uniques entity_user_unique/one_owner; Entity.php:401-421 route key slug/memberships/users/owner; UserRole.php:534-537 manageable; EntityPolicy.php:595-617 + EntityMembershipPolicy.php:555-571 match task; EntityController.php:31-43 pick session+audit+redirect; Dashboard.php:68-70 Members.php:115-120 Settings.php:270-276 mount authorize; Members.php:126-139 addMember exists+duplicate, 157-162 assignRole Rule::in manageable, 182-194 last-manager guard; Settings.php:282-287 slug unique ignore, 313-328 delete+session, 336-351 transfer atomic admin-only + 403 vanished owner

scope.evidence: Diff only adds entities/memberships models, UserRole, policies, factories, 2 migrations, EntityController pick, Dashboard/Members/Settings Livewire + Blade, routes entity.pick/dashboard/members/settings, lang/en+pt_BR ui keys + pt_BR validation attributes, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md, tests/Feature/EntityTest.php; no onboarding/switcher/middleware/navbar/billing/restore

security.evidence: Gate::authorize everywhere: EntityController.php:33, Dashboard.php:70, Members.php:124,155,180, Settings.php:271,280,311,332; #[Locked] Entity Dashboard.php:65 Members.php:110 Settings.php:258 plus findMembership entity-scope check Members.php:229 and transfer scoped admin queries Settings.php:337-345; fixed Employee role Members.php:136-139; Rule::in manageable Members.php:158; Blade {{ }} only

simplicity.evidence: Minimum lean change reusing Eloquent relations, policies/Gate, Log audit channel, existing Blade components; no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityTest.php covers DB second-owner + duplicate, model helpers, both policies, pick success/forbidden + session untouched, auth/verified, dashboard owner-only settings link/notice, cross-entity 403, addMember duplicate/unknown, employee 403 add/assign, assignRole owner/bogus, removeMember owner/foreign/last-manager, self-leave + session clear, settings save/slug-unique/swap-tamper, delete soft+session, transfer atomic/rejects/vanished/locales

review.summary: Implements the full entities/memberships model, policies, pick endpoint, and Livewire dashboard/members/settings pages with thorough Pest tests covering auth, validation, and tamper paths. Blocked from approval by two convention deviations: missing #[Validate] attributes on Livewire inputs and domain writes in components instead of app/Actions/*.
